Welcome to RpubsEncrypt

This is a sample self-contained HTML file used for testing the encryption functionality of the RpubsEncrypt package.

Purpose of this File

  • To demonstrate how to encrypt a self-contained HTML file using the self_contained_encrypt function.
  • To serve as a default test file when users do not provide their own HTML file.

How to Use It

If you are using RpubsEncrypt without providing an input file, this example file will be used automatically.

Try running:

self_contained_encrypt(password = "test123", self_contained = TRUE)

More Information

For more details, visit the RpubsEncrypt GitHub repository.
